# Omkar Shubham Garden - Wedding & Celebration Venue

> Premier garden venue in Khanapur, Karnataka for weddings, receptions, and family celebrations

## About
Omkar Shubham Garden is a family-trusted celebration venue located near Khanapur, Karnataka, India. We specialize in weddings, receptions, sangeet ceremonies, haldi functions, engagements, and family gatherings.

## Key Features
- Capacity: Up to 3,000 guests
- Parking: 100+ vehicle spaces
- Rating: 4.9/5 (320+ Google reviews)
- Experience: 15+ years hosting celebrations
- Location: 1.5 km from Khanapur town on Jamboti Road
- Facilities: Generator backup, dressing suites, wheelchair accessible, overnight accommodation

## Services
- Wedding ceremonies (Vivaha)
- Reception events
- Sangeet & Haldi ceremonies
- Engagement ceremonies
- Birthday & anniversary celebrations
- Corporate gatherings

## Spaces
- Open Mandap: Up to 500 guests, 5000 sq ft
- Pavilion: 800 guests capacity
- Dining Area: 400 seating
- Garden setting with areca palm canopy

## Location
Near Ramgurwardi Cross, Jamboti Road, Khanapur, Karnataka 591302, India
Coordinates: 15°38'22"N 74°31'08"E
